scope: Reference values for the original policy constructions and coefficient verification

coefficient_neighborhood.coordinate_convention: Separate absolute changes in climate and national biodiversity coefficients, each bounded by r in their original numeric units, restricted to nonnegative coefficients; zero biodiversity coefficients stay zero when preserving instrument counts
coefficient_neighborhood.sufficient_condition: r * (range_s a_is + range_s B_is) <= epsilon * q_i for every unit

exact_breadth_verification.json.arithmetic: Exact rational scalar envelopes and outcome sums from stored float64 technology; original 1e-8 effective-target allowance
exact_breadth_verification.json.endpoint_logic: Every breakpoint response set contains neighboring open-cell responses. Universal compliance cannot increase at a breakpoint, including zero. Maximum robust coverage is therefore attained on an open cell.

exact_climate_only_intervals.json.scope: Merged regions of compliant open price cells
exact_climate_only_intervals.json.breakpoint_convention: Internal breakpoints are not certified by this export. Additional tied actions can invalidate compliance at a breakpoint even when both adjacent open cells comply. Maximum common coverage over open cells remains exact.

verification.json.coverage_bounds: Exact rational reconstruction from all original actions and cross-country price-cell aggregation

weak_climate_only_exclusions.json.arithmetic: Exact rational full affine payoff sets and optimistic coordinate maxima; effective target allowance 1e-8
